faq.description: If you have more questions, book a free consultation.

items.question: Are RedBridge Consulting job placements real and verified?
items.answer: Yes. All partner employers currently hold valid 482 sponsorship eligibility. Company names, industries, and sponsorship status are provided directly during the free consultation. There is no payment required and no need to commit first. If there is no suitable pathway for you, we will tell you directly during the consultation and charge nothing.

items.question: What is the difference between the 482 and 186 employer-sponsored visas?
items.text1: allows you to work in Australia for a sponsoring employer for up to 4 years.
items.text2: can lead directly to permanent residency. Many clients first enter on a 482 visa and then transition to the 186 pathway after working with the same employer for 2 to 3 years. We explain the complete strategy during the free consultation.

items.question: How long does a 482 employer-sponsored visa usually take in Australia?
items.suffix: . Timing depends on the occupation, whether the employer already holds sponsorship approval, and the Department's current processing pace. We provide a more specific estimate based on your case during the free consultation.

items.question: How long does Victoria state nomination under the 190 visa usually take?
items.answer: Victoria 190 state nomination usually takes around 2 to 12 months. Timing depends mainly on your occupation, current points score, and invitation rounds. We will assess which states are more realistic for your profile and give you a practical estimate during consultation.

items.question: Can international students apply even without permanent residency or work experience?
items.prefix: Absolutely. Our pathways are designed for international students and skilled professionals at different stages. Our
items.suffix: helps students build genuine local work experience aligned with migration requirements. Employer-sponsored pathways can also connect you directly with employers offering roles and nomination support. You do not need PR or an existing job to begin planning.

items.question: How much does skilled migration cost in Australia?
items.prefix: At RedBridge, your initial consultation is
items.suffix: . Our program fees start from AUD 50,000 depending on the service type. Government visa application fees are additional and are usually around AUD 3,000 to 8,000 depending on the visa category. All costs are set out clearly in the formal client agreement, including service fees, government charges, and legal fees through Insight Idea.

items.question: Can migration consulting fees be paid in instalments?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a milestone-based 3 to 4 stage payment structure, so you only pay at successful milestones rather than all at once. All payment arrangements are written into the formal client agreement. You can pay by bank transfer, PayID, or BPAY.

items.question: What is the skills assessment success guarantee?
items.answer: If you complete our program but your skills assessment is unsuccessful, we continue supporting you at no extra charge until you pass. Our programs are designed to align closely with the assessment standards of CAANZ, ACS, and AMI, including required work duration, document format, and supporting evidence.
